subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Kevin bought shoes that made a squeaking sound on the school floor.”?
options: Every Friday, the teacher checked each desk.
Every step in the hallway sounded loud.
Every morning before school, Mrs. Liu cleaned the hallway.
They did not want to join loud conversations every day.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every Friday, the teacher checked each desk.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Every step in the hallway sounded loud.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Every morning before school, Mrs. Liu cleaned the hallway.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They did not want to join loud conversations every day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Every step in the hallway sounded loud.」，答案為「Every step in the hallway sounded loud.」。
